response.sql:
WITH combined_data AS (
  SELECT 
    f.orderslink,
    o.ordertune,
    f.rebtotal,
    f.rebrate,
    f.feerate
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    orderslink,
    ordertune,
    AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebate,
    AVG((rebrate - feerate) / feerate) as avg_relative_gap
  FROM combined_data
  GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(rebtotal) as overall_avg_rebate
  FROM combined_data
),
ranked_results AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.orderslink,
    gs.ordertune,
    gs.avg_rebate,
    gs.avg_relative_gap,
    gs.avg_rebate - os.overall_avg_rebate as margin_above_overall
  FROM group_stats gs
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
  WHERE gs.avg_rebate > os.overall_avg_rebate
)
SELECT 
  orderslink,
  ordertune,
  avg_rebate,
  avg_relative_gap,
  margin_above_overall
FROM ranked_results
ORDER BY margin_above_overall DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: feerate is non-zero for all records; division by zero in the relative gap calculation (rebrate - feerate) / feerate is not possible
